# Ubuntu Software Application Interface

## System Header Bar
- **Left Side:**
  - "Activities" text
  - "Ubuntu Software" text with application icon
- **Center:**
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 01:03"
  - Notification bell icon
- **Right Side:**
  - User account icon
  - Sound volume icon
  - Power button icon

## Application Window
### Window Controls
- **Top Left:**
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
- **Top Center:**
  - Tab navigation with three options:
    - "Explore" (currently selected, with magnifying glass icon)
    - "Installed" (with checkmark icon)
    - "Updates" (with circular arrow icon, with orange dot indicating updates available)
- **Top Right:**
  - Minimize button (dash icon)
  - Maximize button (square icon)
  - Close button (X icon)

### Main Content Area
#### Application Display
- **Logo:**
  - Large circular logo with dark blue background and three white horizontal stripes
  - Orange crescent shape wrapping around the left side of the logo
  - Smaller circular logo with the same design, partially overlapping the larger one
- **Text:**
  - "Eclipse" in bold black text
  - Subtext: "Extensible Tool Platform and Java IDE"

#### Categories Section
- **Heading:**
  - "Categories" in bold black text
- **Category Buttons (Grid Layout):**
  - **Row 1:**
    - "Art and Design" with image icon
    - "Books and Reference" with book icon
    - "Development" with wrench icon
  - **Row 2:**
    - "Devices and IoT" with device icon
    - "Education" with document icon
    - "Entertainment" with film strip icon
  - **Row 3:**
    - "Finance" with calculator icon
    - "Games" with game controller icon
    - "Health and Fitness" with heart icon
  - **Row 4:**
    - "Music and Audio" with musical note icon
    - "News and Weather" with sun icon
    - "Personalisation" with monitor icon

## Desktop Environment
### Left Dock
- **Application Icons (Top to Bottom):**
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird email client
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC media player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP image editor
  - File manager (folder icon)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange "A" icon)
  - Help icon (blue question mark)
  - Trash icon (recycle bin)
- **Bottom:**
  - Grid icon for application launcher

### Desktop Background
- Geometric pattern with gradient from dark purple to red-orange
- "Home" folder icon in bottom right corner

### Cursor
- White arrow cursor positioned near the right edge of the application window
